Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
"Jon Stahler" <sta...@staff.uiuc.edu> wrote in
news:J%oo7.2855$rT2....@vixen.cso.uiuc.edu:

> Hell, I'd most likely buy 2 or 3 starters and know QUITE a few people
> who would do the same just to get Ian Forestal! Just my 2 cents...

Here's something I don't understand. Why are people so gung-ho on Ian
Forestal?

He's an 8-cap with AUS DOM THA and all inferiors... but what decks does
he REALLY fit in? I mean, seriously. Look at the other 8-caps running
around. I don't believe there's currently a single clan who can't get all
three superior in-clans on an 8-cap or less... meaning that unless you're
playing Tremere, there's always a better vampire to put in your crypt than
Ian. Actually, I think the Lasombra have to go to a 9-cap, but he only
shares one discipline with them anyway.

Sure, he's neat for 'trick decks'. Sometimes he makes a great SECOND 8-
cap vampire; I stuck him in my !Ventrue vote deck because he has
AUS/DOM/for, he's a legitimate target for Cardinal Benediction, and he can
even play Voter Captivation if I lean towards the Presence angle. But I
had Gustav Mallenhous in first, and I had Kij Dansky in second.

It seems that the way to get the 'best' use out of Ian is to include him
in a deck that makes use of at least TWO of his disciplines... meaning a
Tremere, !Tremere, !Ventrue, or Malkavian deck. Possibly even an Assamite
deck now, for another AUS/THA/cel or AUS/THA/qui vampire.

--
Derek

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:
> Here's something I don't understand. Why are people so gung-ho on Ian
> Forestal?
>

Aside from the deck types you mentioned: Tremere with cel, Tremere
with for, aus/dom/pre decks (not as bad as it sounds), gun decks (for
Magic of the Smith, Diguised Weapon, cel, DOM/AUS for bleed/vote
defense), Giovanni with AUS or THA or cel, Lasombra decks with obf,
DOM/pro decks, FoS combat decks (so hard to get Serpentis along with
any respectable combat discipline), nec/qui/tha (in case you wanna try
and make Patrizia useful), Ravnos with aus, the list goes on. Also,
with !Tremere, you can play Ian Forrestal, Infernal Pact, Infernal
Familiar, plus some skill cards, and you've effectively got 4 clan
disciplines to choose from (with the 4th one being whatever you
want... and if it's pot, obf, or nec, you win again).

Admittedly, he's not great for formula decks, straight clan decks, or
most tier 1 tournament decks, but not everyone plays the boring decks
all the time. Half the fun of Jyhad is building your own deck, and if
you can build something really bizarre that actually somewhat works,
you feel so much better. Witness the Recycling Aurura deck, which I
am very proud of.

Messages.Author: Alex Broadhead
Messages.Body:
Derek Ray <lor...@yahoo.com> wrote in message news:<Xns911C7486...@198.99.146.10>...

> Here's something I don't understand. Why are people so gung-ho on Ian
> Forestal?
>
> He's an 8-cap with AUS DOM THA and all inferiors... but what decks does
> he REALLY fit in? I mean, seriously. Look at the other 8-caps running
> around. I don't believe there's currently a single clan who can't get all
> three superior in-clans on an 8-cap or less... meaning that unless you're
> playing Tremere, there's always a better vampire to put in your crypt than
> Ian. Actually, I think the Lasombra have to go to a 9-cap, but he only
> shares one discipline with them anyway.

The Lasombra, as you point out, and also the !Ventrue, whose lowest
capacity vampire with all three superior in-clans is Quentin at 9.
(Lazverinus is the only other qualifier, BTW, at 10.) If you're just
looking for AUS DOM FOR, of course, there's also Roxanne and Bindusara
at 9 as well. The Toreador of the Camarilla also have to go to 9 to
find Andreas, but the !Toreador bring plenty of support with two
7-caps.

All of which is kind of OT. Trying to tie it in: Ian does fit nicely
into some !Ventrue concepts, as you yourself went on to point out,
with his AUS DOM for and possible reinforcement of cel, obt, pot, pre,
pro, or tha, depending on which of the off-clan possibilities with
significant representation in-clan your are trying to supplement. I
generally find him too expensive for the benefit myself, though.

Alex
